<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const pgTrack = ref(null)
const pgIdx = ref(0)
const pgNames = ['GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra', 'Muse Image']
function pgOnScroll(e) {
  const el = e.target
  if (el && el.clientWidth) pgIdx.value = Math.round(el.scrollLeft / el.clientWidth)
}
function pgGo(i) {
  const el = pgTrack.value
  if (el) el.scrollTo({ left: i * el.clientWidth, behavior: 'smooth' })
}
</script>


<div class="pg-wrap">
  <div class="pg-mast">
    <div>
      <h1>Prompt <em>Gallery</em></h1>
      <div class="pg-tag">收藏在网上看到的 AIGC 提示词：一张图，一段词，附出处 · 持续收集中</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pg-stats">已收藏 1 条</div>
  </div>

  <div class="pg-card pg-card-duo">
    <div class="pg-view">
      <div class="pg-track" ref="pgTrack" @scroll="pgOnScroll">
        <figure class="pg-slide"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra 生成效果"><figcaption>GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra</figcaption></figure>
        <figure class="pg-slide"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Muse Image 生成效果"><figcaption>Muse Image</figcaption></figure>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="pg-arrow pg-prev" aria-label="上一张" :disabled="pgIdx === 0" @click="pgGo(pgIdx - 1)">‹</button>
      <button type="button" class="pg-arrow pg-next" aria-label="下一张" :disabled="pgIdx === pgNames.length - 1" @click="pgGo(pgIdx + 1)">›</button>
      <div class="pg-dots">
        <button type="button" v-for="(n, i) in pgNames" :key="i" class="pg-dot" :class="{ on: pgIdx === i }" @click="pgGo(i)">{{ n }}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pg-body">
      <div class="pg-meta"><span class="pg-no">No.002</span><span class="pg-chip">电影感</span><span class="pg-chip">国风山水</span><span class="pg-chip">越肩镜头</span></div>
      <h3>红绸悬山</h3>
      <p class="pg-prompt">Cinematic over-the-shoulder shot from directly behind a mysterious young Chinese woman, her loosely pinned black hair, left shoulder and a small section of translucent vermilion-red silk softly blurred in the extreme foreground, the woman occupying the left edge of the frame, camera focus locked on a distant mysterious red silk canopy floating silently between immense Chinese karst moutains, ancient Chinese temple rooftops emerging from cold teal mist far below, selective golden light illuminating the distant silk, deep charcoal shadows, dramatic chiaroscuro, intimate observer perspective, layered depth, strong cinematic tension, photorealistic surreal photography, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, asymmertical widescreen framing</p>
      <div class="pg-src">提示词由 Allen 收藏（2026-11-09）；窗口内是不同模型用同一段提示词生成的图，左右滑动切换</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <p class="pg-more">新的收藏会陆续补进来：看到好的图和词，就往这里放一条。</p>
</div>

<style>
